=> $qtyMaxAllowed,
        'qty_receivable_max' => $qtyReceivableMax
    ];
}

try {
    switch ($task) {

        case 'list_po_open':
            // HANYA MENGAMBIL PO YANG MEMILIKI SISA QTY BELUM DI-GRN
            $sql = "SELECT p.id, p.po_number AS ref_no, p.po_date AS tx_date, 
                           p.supplier_id, 
                           COALESCE(sup.id, p.supplier_id) AS legacy_supplier_id, 
                           sup.name AS supplier_name,
                           p.currency_id, UPPER(TRIM(cur.init)) AS currency_code,
                           COALESCE(NULLIF(p.exch_rate,0),1) AS exch_rate
                    FROM purchase_orders p
                    LEFT JOIN m_suppliers sup ON sup.id = p.supplier_id
                    LEFT JOIN m_currency cur ON cur.id = p.currency_id
                    JOIN po_items pd ON pd.po_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT po_item_id, SUM(qty_received) AS total_rcv
                        FROM grn_dtl
                        GROUP BY po_item_id
                    ) g ON g.po_item_id = pd.id
                    WHERE p.status IN ('" . implode("','", GRN_PO_STATUS_LIST) . "')
                    GROUP BY p.id, p.po_number, p.po_date, p.supplier_id, sup.id, sup.name, p.currency_id, cur.init, p.exch_rate
                    HAVING SUM(pd.qty) - COALESCE(SUM(g.total_rcv), 0) > 0.0001
                    ORDER BY p.po_date DESC";
            $result = pg_query($sql);
            PgOrFail($result, 'Gagal load daftar PO');
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => pg_fetch_all($result) ?: []]);
            break;

        case 'read_po_items':
            $po_id  = (int)($_REQUEST['po_id'] ?? 0);
            $grn_id = (int)($_REQUEST['grn_id'] ?? 0);

            $sql = "SELECT pd.id AS po_dtl_id, pd.material_id AS item_id, pd.description AS item_name, 
                           pd.qty AS qty_ordered, pd.unit_price
                    FROM po_items pd
                    WHERE pd.po_id = $1
                    ORDER BY pd.id";
            $result = pg_query_params($sql, [$po_id]);
            PgOrFail($result, 'Gagal load detail PO');
            $rows = pg_fetch_all($result) ?: [];

            $data = [];
            foreach ($rows as $r) {
                $poQty = (float)$r['qty_ordered'];
                $tol   = GetPoDtlTolerance($r['po_dtl_id'], $poQty, $grn_id);

                // Cek apakah item ini milik GRN yang sedang diedit
                $ownResult = pg_query_params(
                    "SELECT qty_received, unit_cost FROM grn_dtl WHERE po_item_id = $1 AND grn_hdr_id = $2",
                    [$r['po_dtl_id'], $grn_id]
                );
                PgOrFail($ownResult, 'Gagal cek baris grn_dtl existing');
                $own = pg_fetch_assoc($ownResult);

                // Hitung sisa murni PO (PO_Qty - Received_Others)
                $sisaQtyPure = max(0, $poQty - $tol['others_qty']);

                // Sisa maksimal yang diizinkan (Toleransi 10%)
                $sisaQtyBolehditerima = $tol['qty_receivable_max'];

                // Jika Sisa Qty Murni <= 0 dan bukan dalam mode Edit item terkait, skip (jangan tampilkan)
                if ($sisaQtyPure <= 0.0001 && !$own) {
                    continue;
                }

                $data[] = [
                    'po_dtl_id'             => $r['po_dtl_id'],
                    'item_id'               => $r['item_id'],
                    'item_name'             => $r['item_name'],
                    'qty_ordered'           => $poQty,
                    'unit_price'            => (float)$r['unit_price'],
                    'qty_received'          => $tol['others_qty'],
                    'sisa_qty_po'           => $sisaQtyPure,
                    'qty_max_allowed'       => $tol['qty_max_allowed'],
                    'qty_receivable_max'    => $sisaQtyBolehditerima,
                    'qty_received_this_grn' => $own ? (float)$own['qty_received'] : $sisaQtyPure,
                    'unit_cost_this_grn'    => $own ? (float)$own['unit_cost'] : (float)$r['unit_price']
                ];
            }

            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($data), 'data' => $data,
                              'currency' => GrnCurrencyInfo($po_id, $grn_id)]);
            break;

        case 'read':
            $sql = "SELECT g.id, g.ref_no, g.grn_date, g.status, g.remark,
                           p.po_number AS po_ref_no, g.po_id, s.id AS supplier_id, s.name AS supplier_name,
                           (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty_received),0) FROM grn_dtl d WHERE d.grn_hdr_id = g.id) AS total_qty,
                           (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty_received * unit_cost),0) FROM grn_dtl d WHERE d.grn_hdr_id = g.id) AS total_amount,
                           (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty_received * unit_cost_base),0) FROM grn_dtl d WHERE d.grn_hdr_id = g.id) AS total_base,
                           UPPER(TRIM(cur.init)) AS currency_code, COALESCE(NULLIF(g.exch_rate,0),1) AS exch_rate
                    FROM grn_hdr g
                    LEFT JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.id = g.po_id
                    LEFT JOIN m_suppliers s ON s.id = g.supplier_id
                    LEFT JOIN m_currency cur ON cur.id = g.currency_id
                    ORDER BY g.grn_date DESC, g.id DESC";
            $result = pg_query($sql);
            PgOrFail($result, 'Gagal load daftar GRN');
            $all = pg_fetch_all($result) ?: [];
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($all), 'data' => $all]);
            break;

        case 'read_grn_items':
            $grn_id = (int)($_REQUEST['grn_id'] ?? 0);
            $sql = "SELECT item_name, qty_received AS qty, unit_cost AS unit_price, unit_cost_base
                    FROM grn_dtl WHERE grn_hdr_id = $1 ORDER BY id";
            $result = pg_query_params($sql, [$grn_id]);
            PgOrFail($result, 'Gagal load item GRN');
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => pg_fetch_all($result) ?: [],
                              'currency' => GrnCurrencyInfo(0, $grn_id)]);
            break;

        case 'read_edit':
            $id = (int)($_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);
            $hdrResult = pg_query_params("SELECT * FROM grn_hdr WHERE id = $1", [$id]);
            PgOrFail($hdrResult, 'Gagal load GRN');
            $hdr = pg_fetch_assoc($hdrResult);
            if (!$hdr) throw new Exception('Data tidak ditemukan');
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $hdr]);
            break;

        case 'create':
            $po_id       = (int)($_REQUEST['po_id'] ?? 0);
            $supplier_id = (int)($_REQUEST['supplier_id'] ?? 0);
            $grn_date    = $_REQUEST['grn_date'] ?? date('Y-m-d');
            $remark      = $_REQUEST['remark'] ?? null;
            $arrItems    = json_decode($_REQUEST['arrItems'] ?? '[]', true);
            $created_by  = $_SESSION['user_id'] ?? null;

            if (!$po_id) throw new Exception('PO belum dipilih');

            if (!$supplier_id) {
                $supRes = pg_query_params("SELECT supplier_id FROM purchase_orders WHERE id = $1", [$po_id]);
                if ($supRes && $supRow = pg_fetch_assoc($supRes)) {
                    $supplier_id = (int)$supRow['supplier_id'];
                }
            }

            if (!$supplier_id) throw new Exception('Supplier tidak ditemukan dari PO');
            if (empty($arrItems)) throw new Exception('Minimal 1 item harus diisi qty diterima');

            // PO harus berstatus Disetujui; mata uang & kurs PO dibekukan di GRN
            $poRes = pg_query_params("SELECT status, currency_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(exch_rate,0),1) AS exch_rate
                                        FROM purchase_orders WHERE id = $1", [$po_id]);
            PgOrFail($poRes, 'Gagal cek PO');
            $poRow = pg_fetch_assoc($poRes);
            if (!$poRow) throw new Exception('PO tidak ditemukan');
            if (!in_array($poRow['status'], GRN_PO_STATUS_LIST, true)) {
                throw new Exception('GRN hanya dapat dibuat dari PO berstatus ' . implode('/', GRN_PO_STATUS_LIST) .
                                    ' (status PO saat ini: ' . $poRow['status'] . ').');
            }
            $po_currency = $poRow['currency_id'] !== null ? (int)$poRow['currency_id'] : null;
            $po_rate     = (float)$poRow['exch_rate'];

            pg_query('BEGIN');
            SetPgAppUser();
            $ref_no = CreateRefNo('grn_hdr', 'ref_no', 'GRN');

            $hdrResult = pg_query_params(
                "INSERT INTO grn_hdr (ref_no, grn_date, po_id, supplier_id, status, remark, created_by, created_at, currency_id, exch_rate)
                 VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,'open',$5,$6,NOW(),$7,$8) RETURNING id",
                [$ref_no, $grn_date, $po_id, $supplier_id, $remark, $created_by, $po_currency, $po_rate]
            );
            PgOrFail($hdrResult, 'Gagal insert grn_hdr');
            $grn_hdr_id = pg_fetch_result($hdrResult, 0, 'id');

            InsertGrnItems($grn_hdr_id, $arrItems, 0, $po_rate);

            pg_query('COMMIT');
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => "GRN {$ref_no} berhasil disimpan.", 'id' => $grn_hdr_id, 'ref_no' => $ref_no]);
            break;

        case 'update':
            $id          = (int)($_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);
            $po_id       = (int)($_REQUEST['po_id'] ?? 0);
            $supplier_id = (int)($_REQUEST['supplier_id'] ?? 0);
            $grn_date    = $_REQUEST['grn_date'] ?? date('Y-m-d');
            $remark      = $_REQUEST['remark'] ?? null;
            $arrItems    = json_decode($_REQUEST['arrItems'] ?? '[]', true);

            if (!$id) throw new Exception('GRN tidak valid');

            if (!$supplier_id && $po_id) {
                $supRes = pg_query_params("SELECT supplier_id FROM purchase_orders WHERE id = $1", [$po_id]);
                if ($supRes && $supRow = pg_fetch_assoc($supRes)) {
                    $supplier_id = (int)$supRow['supplier_id'];
                }
            }

            if (!$supplier_id) throw new Exception('Supplier belum dipilih');
            if (empty($arrItems)) throw new Exception('Minimal 1 item harus diisi qty diterima');

            $hRes = pg_query_params("SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(exch_rate,0),1) AS exch_rate FROM grn_hdr WHERE id = $1", [$id]);
            PgOrFail($hRes, 'Gagal load kurs GRN');
            $hRow = pg_fetch_assoc($hRes);
            if (!$hRow) throw new Exception('GRN tidak ditemukan');
            $grn_rate = (float)$hRow['exch_rate'];                       // kurs snapshot GRN tidak berubah saat edit

            pg_query('BEGIN');
            SetPgAppUser();

            GuardNoWhReceiving($id, 'diedit');

            $delResult = pg_query_params("DELETE FROM grn_dtl WHERE grn_hdr_id = $1", [$id]);
            PgOrFail($delResult, 'Gagal hapus baris lama grn_dtl');

            $upd = pg_query_params(
                "UPDATE grn_hdr SET supplier_id = $1, grn_date = $2, remark = $3 WHERE id = $4",
                [$supplier_id, $grn_date, $remark, $id]
            );
            PgOrFail($upd, 'Gagal update grn_hdr');

            InsertGrnItems($id, $arrItems, $id, $grn_rate);

            pg_query('COMMIT');
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'GRN berhasil diupdate.', 'id' => $id]);
            break;

        case 'delete':
            $id = (int)($_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);
            if (!$id) throw new Exception('GRN tidak valid');

            pg_query('BEGIN');
            SetPgAppUser();

            GuardNoWhReceiving($id, 'dihapus');

            $delDtl = pg_query_params("DELETE FROM grn_dtl WHERE grn_hdr_id = $1", [$id]);
            PgOrFail($delDtl, 'Gagal hapus grn_dtl');

            $delHdr = pg_query_params("DELETE FROM grn_hdr WHERE id = $1", [$id]);
            PgOrFail($delHdr, 'Gagal hapus grn_hdr');

            pg_query('COMMIT');
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'GRN berhasil dihapus.']);
            break;

        default:
            throw new Exception('Task tidak dikenali: ' . htmlspecialchars($task));
    }
} catch (Exception $e) {
    @pg_query('ROLLBACK');
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()]);
}

function InsertGrnItems($grn_hdr_id, $arrItems, $exclude_grn_hdr_id, $rate = 1.0) {
    $any_line = false;

    foreach ($arrItems as $it) {
        $qty = (float)($it['qty_received'] ?? 0);
        if ($qty <= 0) continue;

        $poResult = pg_query_params("SELECT qty AS po_qty FROM po_items WHERE id = $1", [$it['po_dtl_id']]);
        PgOrFail($poResult, 'Gagal cek qty PO');
        $poRow = pg_fetch_assoc($poResult);
        if (!$poRow) throw new Exception('Baris PO tidak ditemukan (po_dtl_id=' . $it['po_dtl_id'] . ')');

        $tol = GetPoDtlTolerance($it['po_dtl_id'], (float)$poRow['po_qty'], $exclude_grn_hdr_id);
        if ($qty > $tol['qty_receivable_max'] + 0.0001) {
            throw new Exception("Qty GRN untuk {$it['item_name']} ({$qty}) melebihi batas toleransi +10% PO (sisa maksimal: " . round($tol['qty_receivable_max'], 4) . ")");
        }

        $dtlResult = pg_query_params(
            "INSERT INTO grn_dtl (grn_hdr_id, po_item_id, item_id, item_name, qty_received, unit_cost, unit_cost_base, remark)
             VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8)",
            [
                $grn_hdr_id, $it['po_dtl_id'], $it['item_id'], $it['item_name'],
                $qty, $it['unit_cost'], round((float)$it['unit_cost'] * $rate, 4), $it['remark'] ?? null
            ]
        );
        PgOrFail($dtlResult, 'Gagal insert grn_dtl');

        $any_line = true;
    }

    if (!$any_line) {
        throw new Exception('Tidak ada baris dengan qty > 0');
    }
}

function GuardNoWhReceiving($grn_hdr_id, $actionLabel) {
    $chkResult = pg_query_params(
        "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.qty_received),0) AS total_wh
         FROM wh_receiving_dtl d
         JOIN wh_receiving_hdr h ON h.id = d.wh_receiving_hdr_id AND h.status = 'posted'
         JOIN grn_dtl gd ON gd.id = d.grn_dtl_id
         WHERE gd.grn_hdr_id = $1",
        [$grn_hdr_id]
    );
    PgOrFail($chkResult, 'Gagal cek qty yang sudah di-WH Rcv');
    $chk = pg_fetch_assoc($chkResult);
    if ((float)$chk['total_wh'] > 0) {
        throw new Exception("GRN tidak bisa {$actionLabel} -- sudah ada WH Rcv terkait. Reverse WH Rcv-nya dulu.");
    }
}

    // ------------------------------------------------------------

            $stmt = $pdo->prepare("

                FROM tax_exchange_rate_hdr
                ORDER BY start_date DESC, id DESC
                LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset
            ");

            $stmt->bindValue(':offset', $start, PDO::PARAM_INT);
            $stmt->execute();
            $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

            echo json_encode([
                'success' => true,
                'totalRecord' => $totalCount,
                'data' => $data
            ]);
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()]);
        }
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. READ DETAIL GRID (Rincian Kurs per Mata Uang)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'read_detail':
        try {
            $hdrId = intval($_POST['hdr_id'] ?? $_REQUEST['hdr_id'] ?? 0);
            if ($hdrId <= 0) {
                // Default ke header terbaru jika tidak spesifik
                $hdrId = $pdo->query("SELECT id FROM tax_exchange_rate_hdr ORDER BY start_date DESC LIMIT 1")->fetchColumn();
            }

            if (!$hdrId) {
                echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => []]);
                exit;
            }

            $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
                SELECT 
                    d.id, d.hdr_id, d.currency_id, d.currency_code, d.currency_name, 
                    d.unit_multiplier, d.rate AS rate_kmk, d.rate_per_unit AS rate_effective,
                    d.prev_rate, d.change_amount, d.change_direction
                FROM tax_exchange_rate_dtl d
                WHERE d.hdr_id = :hdr_id
                ORDER BY d.currency_code ASC
            ");
            $stmt->execute(['hdr_id' => $hdrId]);
            $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

            echo json_encode([
                'success' => true,
                'hdr_id' => $hdrId,
                'data' => $data
            ]);
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()]);
        }
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. FETCH NOW (Tarik Otomatis dari Kemenkeu)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'fetch_now':
    case 'sync':

                    'message' => $res['message']
                ]);
            }
        } catch (Exception $e) {

        }
        break;

    // 4. DELETE RECORD
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'delete':

        } catch (Exception $e) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()]);
        }
        break;

    default:
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Task tidak dikenali.']);
        break;
}

<?php
/**
 * rabCRD.php
 * ============================================================
 * Backend Controller untuk RAB Material per Proyek (rab.js).
 *
 * PERBAIKAN dari versi sebelumnya:
 * - [FIX FATAL] $db tidak pernah diinisialisasi ($db = new crud() hilang) --
 *   penyebab "Call to a member function prepare() on null".
 * - [FIX SKEMA] Tabel sumber SUDAH TIDAK ADA: m_materials, rab_materials,
 *   v_material_budget_monitoring (dihapus saat konsolidasi ke materials/
 *   budget_items). Ditulis ulang memakai materials + budget_items, dengan
 *   status ON TRACK/WARNING/OVERBUDGET dihitung inline (menggantikan view
 *   yang sudah tidak ada) dari budget_items + material_out_items.
 * - Kontrak JSON (nama field: budget_qty, unit_price, tolerance_pct, dst)
 *   DIPERTAHANKAN PERSIS -- rab.js tidak perlu diubah sama sekali.
 * - budget_items.item_name (NOT NULL) diisi otomatis dari materials.material_name.
 * - [MULTI CURRENCY] Satu mata uang anggaran per proyek (projects.budget_currency_id) + kurs ke
 *   mata uang dasar. Harga satuan RAB = mata uang anggaran. Nilai pemakaian aktual (material out,
 *   dalam mata uang dasar) dikonversi ke mata uang anggaran memakai kurs anggaran.
 *   Mata uang tidak bisa diganti bila proyek sudah punya PO (non-batal) atau pemakaian material.
 *   Butuh sql/2026-10-01.rab_currency.sql.
 * - Butuh migration_rab_budget_items.sql (unique index project_id+material_id
 *   utk category='Material') supaya ON CONFLICT di save_rab berfungsi.
 * ============================================================
 */

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/fx.func.php';

session_start();
header('Content-Type: application/json');

$db = new crud(); // [FIX] sebelumnya tidak ada -- inilah penyebab fatal error

function sendJsonResponse($success, $data = [], $message = '', $extra = []) {
    $response = array_merge(['success' => $success, 'message' => $message], $extra);
    if ($success) {
        if (is_array($data) && isset($data['data'])) {
            $response['data'] = $data['data'];
            if (isset($data['totalCount'])) $response['totalCount'] = $data['totalCount'];
        } else {
            $response['data'] = $data;
        }
    }
    echo json_encode($response);
    exit;
}

/** Alasan mata uang anggaran proyek tidak boleh diganti (null = masih boleh). */
function rab_currency_lock_reason($db, int $projectId): ?string {
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT 1 FROM public.po_items poi
                          JOIN public.purchase_orders po ON po.id = poi.po_id
                         WHERE po.project_id = :p AND po.status <> 'Dibatalkan' LIMIT 1");
    $st->execute([':p' => $projectId]);
    if ($st->fetchColumn()) return 'Proyek ini sudah memiliki PO.';

    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT 1 FROM public.material_out_header WHERE project_id = :p AND status = 'posted' LIMIT 1");
    $st->execute([':p' => $projectId]);
    if ($st->fetchColumn()) return 'Proyek ini sudah memiliki pemakaian material (issue).';
    return null;
}

// Pecahan status RAB dipakai di dua tempat (list_projects & load_rab) --
// didefinisikan sekali di sini supaya konsisten.
// - OVERBUDGET : qty terpakai melebihi qty_plan + toleransi
// - WARNING    : qty terpakai melebihi qty_plan, tapi masih dalam toleransi
// - ON TRACK   : sisanya
const RAB_USAGE_CTE = "
    WITH usage AS (
        SELECT moh.project_id, moi.material_id,
               SUM(moi.qty_out) AS qty_out,
               SUM(moi.qty_out * moi.unit_cost) AS actual_cost
          FROM material_out_items moi
          JOIN material_out_header moh ON moh.id = moi.material_out_id AND moh.status = 'posted'
         GROUP BY moh.project_id, moi.material_id
    )
";

$task = $_REQUEST['task'] ?? '';

try {
    switch ($task) {

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * 1. LIST_PROJECTS
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'list_projects':
            $start = (int)($_REQUEST['start'] ?? 0);
            $limit = (int)($_REQUEST['limit'] ?? 250);
            $query = trim($_REQUEST['query'] ?? '');

            $whereClauses = [];
            $params = [];
            if ($query !== '') {
                $whereClauses[] = "(p.name ILIKE :query OR c.name ILIKE :query)";
                $params[':query'] = '%' . $query . '%';
            }
            $searchWhere = $whereClauses ? 'WHERE ' . implode(' AND ', $whereClauses) : '';

            $stmtCount = $db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.projects p LEFT JOIN public.clients c ON c.id = p.client_id {$searchWhere}");
            $stmtCount->execute($params);
            $totalCount = (int)$stmtCount->fetchColumn();

            $sql = RAB_USAGE_CTE . "
                SELECT p.id, p.name, c.name AS client_name, p.status,
                       COALESCE(UPPER(TRIM(cur.init)), 'IDR') AS currency_code,
                       COALESCE(NULLIF(p.budget_exch_rate, 0), 1) AS budget_exch_rate,
                       COALESCE(agg.material_count, 0) AS material_count,
                       COALESCE(agg.total_budget_cost, 0) AS total_budget_cost,
                       COALESCE(agg.total_budget_cost, 0) * COALESCE(NULLIF(p.budget_exch_rate, 0), 1) AS total_budget_base,
                       COALESCE(agg.total_actual_cost, 0) / COALESCE(NULLIF(p.budget_exch_rate, 0), 1) AS total_actual_cost,
                       CASE COALESCE(agg.status_rank, 0)
                           WHEN 3 THEN 'OVERBUDGET'
                           WHEN 2 THEN 'WARNING'
                           WHEN 1 THEN 'ON TRACK'
                           ELSE 'NO BUDGET'
                       END AS rab_status
                  FROM public.projects p
                  LEFT JOIN public.clients c ON c.id = p.client_id
                  LEFT JOIN public.m_currency cur ON cur.id = p.budget_currency_id
                  LEFT JOIN (
                      SELECT bi.project_id,
                             COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(bi.qty_plan,0) > 0) AS material_count,
                             SUM(bi.qty_plan * bi.unit_price_plan) AS total_budget_cost,
                             SUM(COALESCE(u.actual_cost, 0)) AS total_actual_cost,
                             MAX(
                                 CASE
                                     WHEN COALESCE(u.qty_out,0) > bi.qty_plan * (1 + COALESCE(bi.tolerance_pct,0)/100) THEN 3
                                     WHEN COALESCE(u.qty_out,0) > bi.qty_plan THEN 2
                                     ELSE 1
                                 END
                             ) AS status_rank
                        FROM public.budget_items bi
                        LEFT JOIN usage u ON u.project_id = bi.project_id AND u.material_id = bi.material_id
                       WHERE bi.category = 'Material'
                       GROUP BY bi.project_id
                  ) agg ON agg.project_id = p.id
                  {$searchWhere}
                  ORDER BY p.id DESC
                  LIMIT :limit OFFSET :start";

            $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
            foreach ($params as $k => $v) { $stmt->bindValue($k, $v); }
            $stmt->bindValue(':limit', $limit, PDO::PARAM_INT);
            $stmt->bindValue(':start', $start, PDO::PARAM_INT);
            $stmt->execute();
            $projects = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

            foreach ($projects as &$p) {
                $p['id'] = (int)$p['id'];
                $p['material_count'] = (int)$p['material_count'];
                $p['total_budget_cost'] = (float)$p['total_budget_cost'];
                $p['total_budget_base'] = (float)$p['total_budget_base'];
                $p['total_actual_cost'] = (float)$p['total_actual_cost'];
                $p['budget_exch_rate'] = (float)$p['budget_exch_rate'];
            }
            sendJsonResponse(true, ['data' => $projects, 'totalCount' => $totalCount]);
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * 1b. LIST_CURRENCIES + 1c. GET_EXCHANGE_RATE (kurs default KMK pada tanggal tertentu)
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'list_currencies':
            $rows = $db->query("SELECT id, init, name FROM public.m_currency ORDER BY init ASC")->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            $baseCur = fx_base_currency($db);
            foreach ($rows as &$r) {
                $r['id'] = (int)$r['id'];
                $r['is_base'] = $baseCur['id'] !== null && $r['id'] === $baseCur['id'];
            }
            sendJsonResponse(true, $rows);
            break;

        case 'get_exchange_rate':
            $cid = (int)($_REQUEST['currency_id'] ?? 0);
            if ($cid <= 0) sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Mata uang tidak valid.');
            sendJsonResponse(true, fx_default_rate($db, $cid, (string)($_REQUEST['date'] ?? '')));
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * 2. LIST_MATERIALS
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'list_materials':
            $stmt = $db->query("SELECT id, material_code, material_name, unit, COALESCE(estimated_price,0) AS estimated_price
                                   FROM public.materials WHERE active IS TRUE ORDER BY material_name ASC");
            $materials = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            foreach ($materials as &$m) {
                $m['id'] = (int)$m['id'];
                $m['estimated_price'] = (float)$m['estimated_price'];
            }
            sendJsonResponse(true, $materials);
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * 3. LOAD_RAB
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'load_rab':
            $projectId = (int)($_REQUEST['project_id'] ?? 0);
            if ($projectId <= 0) sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'ID Proyek tidak valid.');

            $stmtP = $db->prepare("SELECT p.name, p.budget_currency_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.budget_exch_rate, 0), 1) AS budget_exch_rate,
                                          p.budget_rate_date, UPPER(TRIM(cur.init)) AS currency_code
                                     FROM public.projects p
                                     LEFT JOIN public.m_currency cur ON cur.id = p.budget_currency_id
                                    WHERE p.id = :id");
            $stmtP->execute([':id' => $projectId]);
            $proj = $stmtP->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if (!$proj) sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Proyek tidak ditemukan.');
            $projectName = $proj['name'];

            $baseCur = fx_base_currency($db);
            $curId   = $proj['budget_currency_id'] !== null ? (int)$proj['budget_currency_id'] : (int)$baseCur['id'];
            $currencyInfo = [
                'id'            => $curId,
                'code'          => $proj['currency_code'] ?: ($baseCur['code'] ?: 'IDR'),
                'is_base'       => $baseCur['id'] !== null && $curId === $baseCur['id'],
                'base_code'     => $baseCur['code'] ?: 'IDR',
                'exch_rate'     => (float)$proj['budget_exch_rate'],
                'rate_date'     => $proj['budget_rate_date'],
                'locked_reason' => rab_currency_lock_reason($db, $projectId),
            ];

            $sql = RAB_USAGE_CTE . "
                SELECT bi.id, bi.project_id, bi.material_id,
                       m.material_code, m.material_name, m.unit,
                       COALESCE(bi.qty_plan, 0) AS budget_qty,
                       COALESCE(bi.unit_price_plan, 0) AS unit_price,
                       COALESCE(bi.tolerance_pct, 0) AS tolerance_pct,
                       COALESCE(u.qty_out, 0) AS total_qty_out,
                       (COALESCE(bi.qty_plan,0) - COALESCE(u.qty_out, 0)) AS remaining_qty,
                       CASE WHEN COALESCE(bi.qty_plan,0) > 0
                            THEN (COALESCE(u.qty_out, 0) / bi.qty_plan) * 100
                            ELSE 0 END AS usage_pct,
                       CASE
                           WHEN COALESCE(u.qty_out,0) > COALESCE(bi.qty_plan,0) * (1 + COALESCE(bi.tolerance_pct,0)/100) THEN 'OVERBUDGET'
                           WHEN COALESCE(u.qty_out,0) > COALESCE(bi.qty_plan,0) THEN 'WARNING'
                           ELSE 'ON TRACK'
                       END AS status
                  FROM public.budget_items bi
                  JOIN public.materials m ON m.id = bi.material_id
                  LEFT JOIN usage u ON u.project_id = bi.project_id AND u.material_id = bi.material_id
                 WHERE bi.project_id = :project_id AND bi.category = 'Material'
                 ORDER BY m.material_name ASC";

            $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
            $stmt->execute([':project_id' => $projectId]);
            $items = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

            foreach ($items as &$item) {
                $item['id'] = (int)$item['id'];
                $item['material_id'] = (int)$item['material_id'];
                $item['budget_qty'] = (float)$item['budget_qty'];
                $item['unit_price'] = (float)$item['unit_price'];
                $item['tolerance_pct'] = (float)$item['tolerance_pct'];
                $item['total_qty_out'] = (float)$item['total_qty_out'];
                $item['remaining_qty'] = (float)$item['remaining_qty'];
                $item['usage_pct'] = (float)$item['usage_pct'];
            }
            sendJsonResponse(true, ['name' => $projectName, 'items' => $items, 'currency' => $currencyInfo]);
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * 4. SAVE_RAB
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'save_rab':
            $projectId = (int)($_POST['project_id'] ?? 0);
            $items = json_decode($_POST['items'] ?? '[]', true);

            if ($projectId <= 0) sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'ID Proyek tidak valid.');
            if (!is_array($items)) sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Format data item RAB tidak valid.');

            // --- Mata uang anggaran + kurs (klien lama yang tidak mengirim currency_id -> pertahankan yang tersimpan)
            $stmtCur = $db->prepare("SELECT budget_currency_id FROM public.projects WHERE id = :id");
            $stmtCur->execute([':id' => $projectId]);
            $storedCur = $stmtCur->fetchColumn();
            if ($storedCur === false) sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Proyek tidak ditemukan.');
            $storedCur = $storedCur !== null ? (int)$storedCur : null;

            $baseCur    = fx_base_currency($db);
            $currencyId = (int)($_POST['currency_id'] ?? 0);
            if ($currencyId <= 0) $currencyId = $storedCur ?: (int)$baseCur['id'];
            if ($currencyId <= 0) sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Mata uang anggaran belum dapat ditentukan. Jalankan migrasi mata uang.');

            $stmtChk = $db->prepare("SELECT 1 FROM public.m_currency WHERE id = :id");
            $stmtChk->execute([':id' => $currencyId]);
            if (!$stmtChk->fetchColumn()) sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Mata uang anggaran tidak ditemukan.');

            $exchRate = (float)($_POST['exch_rate'] ?? 1);
            if ($baseCur['id'] !== null && $currencyId === $baseCur['id']) $exchRate = 1.0;      // mata uang dasar selalu berkurs 1
            if ($exchRate <= 0) sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Kurs harus lebih besar dari 0.');

            $rateDate = (string)($_POST['rate_date'] ?? '');
            $rd = DateTime::createFromFormat('Y-m-d', $rateDate);
            if (!$rd || $rd->format('Y-m-d') !== $rateDate) $rateDate = date('Y-m-d');

            if ($storedCur !== null && $currencyId !== $storedCur) {
                $lock = rab_currency_lock_reason($db, $projectId);
                if ($lock !== null) sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Mata uang anggaran tidak dapat diubah. ' . $lock);
            }

            $db->beginTransaction();
            try {
                $stmtProj = $db->prepare("UPDATE public.projects
                                             SET budget_currency_id = :c, budget_exch_rate = :r, budget_rate_date = CAST(:d AS date)
                                           WHERE id = :id");
                $stmtProj->execute([':c' => $currencyId, ':r' => $exchRate, ':d' => $rateDate, ':id' => $projectId]);

                $activeMaterialIds = [];

                // item_name (NOT NULL di budget_items) diambil dari materials.material_name.
                $stmtUpsert = $db->prepare("
                    INSERT INTO public.budget_items
                        (project_id, material_id, category, item_name, unit, qty_plan, unit_price_plan, tolerance_pct, created_at)
                    SELECT :project_id, :material_id, 'Material', m.material_name, m.unit,
                           :budget_qty, :unit_price, :tolerance_pct, NOW()
                      FROM public.materials m WHERE m.id = :material_id
                    ON CONFLICT (project_id, material_id) WHERE category = 'Material' AND material_id IS NOT NULL
                    DO UPDATE SET
                        qty_plan = EXCLUDED.qty_plan,
                        unit_price_plan = EXCLUDED.unit_price_plan,
                        tolerance_pct = EXCLUDED.tolerance_pct,
                        item_name = EXCLUDED.item_name,
                        unit = EXCLUDED.unit
                ");

                foreach ($items as $item) {
                    $materialId = (int)($item['material_id'] ?? 0);
                    $budgetQty  = (float)($item['budget_qty'] ?? 0);
                    $unitPrice  = (float)($item['unit_price'] ?? 0);
                    $tolerance  = (float)($item['tolerance_pct'] ?? 0);

                    if ($materialId > 0 && $budgetQty > 0) {
                        $activeMaterialIds[] = $materialId;
                        $ok = $stmtUpsert->execute([
                            ':project_id' => $projectId, ':material_id' => $materialId,
                            ':budget_qty' => $budgetQty, ':unit_price' => $unitPrice, ':tolerance_pct' => $tolerance
                        ]);
                        if (!$ok || $stmtUpsert->rowCount() === 0) {
                            throw new Exception("Material (id {$materialId}) tidak ditemukan di master materials.");
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Hapus baris RAB Material proyek ini yang tidak lagi ada di grid.
                // Catatan: po_items.budget_item_id -> ON DELETE SET NULL, jadi PO
                // yang sudah pernah dikaitkan ke baris RAB ini tidak ikut terhapus,
                // cuma kaitannya ke baris RAB tersebut hilang.
                if ($activeMaterialIds) {
                    $ph = [];
                    $params = [':project_id' => $projectId];
                    foreach (array_values($activeMaterialIds) as $i => $mid) {
                        $ph[] = ":m{$i}"; $params[":m{$i}"] = $mid;
                    }
                    $stmtDel = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM public.budget_items
                                               WHERE project_id = :project_id AND category = 'Material'
                                                 AND (material_id IS NULL OR material_id NOT IN (" . implode(',', $ph) . "))");
                    $stmtDel->execute($params);
                } else {
                    $stmtDel = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM public.budget_items WHERE project_id = :project_id AND category = 'Material'");
                    $stmtDel->execute([':project_id' => $projectId]);
                }

                $db->commit();
                sendJsonResponse(true, [], 'RAB material berhasil disimpan.');
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
                sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Gagal menyimpan RAB: ' . $e->getMessage());
            }
            break;

        default:
            sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Aksi/Task tidak dikenal.');
            break;
    }
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Database Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'System Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
}

  Document      : Fiscal Config - CRUD Handler
  Called from   : js/m.fiscalconfig.js
  Note          : Tabel ini jadi rujukan AutoPostJournal() -- rule_code
                  dipakai modul transaksi (Sales Invoice, dll) untuk cari

            LEFT JOIN chart_of_accounts c ON c.id = f.credit_account_id

            LIMIT " . intval($limit);

        $stmt = $db->query($sql);

        echo json_encode(['success' => (bool)$row, 'data' => $row ?: new stdClass()]);
        break;

    case 'create':

            exit;
        }

        if (empty($ruleCode)) {

        }
        if (strlen($ruleCode) > 15) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'status' => 'Error', 'message' => 'Rule Code maksimal 15 karakter.']);
            exit;
        }

        $stmtChk = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM fiscal_config WHERE rule_code = :code");
        $stmtChk->execute(['code' => $ruleCode]);
        if ($stmtChk->fetch()) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'status' => 'Error', 'message' => 'Rule Code ini sudah ada.']);
            exit;
        }

        if (empty($_POST['debit_account_id']) || empty($_POST['credit_account_id'])) {

            'rule_name'         => trim($_POST['rule_name'] ?? ''),
            'debit_account_id'  => intval($_POST['debit_account_id']),
            'credit_account_id' => intval($_POST['credit_account_id']),

    // READ DETAIL (untuk panel detail di layar utama)
    // ==============================================================
    case 'read_detail':

            exit;
        }

        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            SELECT f.id, f.rule_code, f.rule_name, f.is_active,

            FROM fiscal_config f

        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $data ?: new stdClass()]);

    // ==============================================================
    case 'update':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 3) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'status' => 'Error', 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }
        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        if ($id <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'status' => 'Error', 'message' => 'ID tidak valid.']);
            exit;
        }

        $ruleCode = trim($_POST['rule_code'] ?? '');
        if (strlen($ruleCode) > 15) {

            exit;
        }

        $db->update('fiscal_config', [

    // ==============================================================
    case 'delete':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);

        $db->query("DELETE FROM fiscal_config WHERE id = {$id}");
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Rule berhasil dihapus.']);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    default:
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'status' => 'Error', 'message' => 'Task tidak dikenali: ' . htmlspecialchars($task)]);
}

<?php
if (!isset($_SESSION)) {
    session_start();
}
date_default_timezone_set('Asia/Jakarta');

include_once "../php-class/crudClass.php";
include_once "../php-func/function.all.php";

$task  = $_POST['task'] ?? '';
$db    = new crud();

switch ($task) {

    // ==========================================
    // 1. READ (Ambil Data Gudang untuk Grid/Store)
    // ==========================================
    case ('read'):

        $limit     = $sResult["limit"];

        $order = "dt.id DESC";

        // Pemanggilan select yang BENAR: ($table, $fields, $where, $order, $limit, $offset)
        $db->select($tableJoin, $fields, $where, $order, $limit, $offset);

        $where  = "id = " . $id;

        $db->select($table, $fields, $where);
        echo $db->getResult();
    break;

    // ==========================================
    // 3. HISTORY DATA (Log Perubahan Warehouse)
    // ==========================================
    case ('HistoryData'):

        $fields = "
            tx_id, date, count,
            case amend_name
                when 'code' then '[EDIT] - Code'
                when 'name' then '[EDIT] - Name'
                when 'description' then '[EDIT] - Description'
                when 'remark' then '[EDIT] - Remark'
                when 'location_id' then '[EDIT] - Location'
                when 'total_row' then '[EDIT] - Total Row'
                when 'col_row' then '[EDIT] - Columns/Row'
                else amend_name
            end ::character varying(200) AS amend_name,
            before_amendment, after_amendment, user_name, user_time
        ";
        $where   = "tx_id::int = " . $id . " and table_name = '" . $table . "'";
        $orderBy = "count desc";

        $db->select("view_single_table_log", $fields, $where, $orderBy);
        echo $db->getResult();
    break;

    // ==========================================
    // 4. CREATE / ADD (Tambah Gudang Baru)
    // ==========================================
    case ('create'):
    case ('add'):
        $location_id = intval($_POST['location_id'] ?? 0);
        $code        = $_POST['code'] ?? '';
        $name        = $_POST['name'] ?? '';
        $total_row   = floatval(str_replace(",", "", $_POST['total_row'] ?? 0));
        $col_row     = floatval(str_replace(",", "", $_POST['col_row'] ?? 0));
        $description = $_POST['description'] ?? '';
        $remark      = $_POST['remark'] ?? '';

        if (!empty($name)) {
            $data = array(
                "location_id" => $location_id,
                "code"        => checksinglequote($code),
                "name"        => checksinglequote($name),
                "total_row"   => $total_row,
                "col_row"     => $col_row,
                "description" => checksinglequote($description),
                "remark"      => checksinglequote($remark)
            );

            if ($db->insert($table, $data)) {
                echo $db->getResult();
            } else {
                echo $db->getResult();
            }
        } else {
            echo json_encode(array(
                "success" => "false",
                "status"  => "Error",
                "message" => "Nama Gudang (Name) wajib diisi."
            ));
        }
    break;

    // ==========================================
    // 5. UPDATE / EDIT (Ubah Data Gudang)
    // ==========================================
    case ('update'):
    case ('edit'):
        $id          = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        $location_id = intval($_POST['location_id'] ?? 0);
        $code        = $_POST['code'] ?? '';
        $name        = $_POST['name'] ?? '';
        $total_row   = floatval(str_replace(",", "", $_POST['total_row'] ?? 0));
        $col_row     = floatval(str_replace(",", "", $_POST['col_row'] ?? 0));
        $description = $_POST['description'] ?? '';
        $remark      = $_POST['remark'] ?? '';

        if ($id > 0) {
            $data = array(
                "location_id" => $location_id,
                "code"        => checksinglequote($code),
                "name"        => checksinglequote($name),
                "total_row"   => $total_row,
                "col_row"     => $col_row,
                "description" => checksinglequote($description),
                "remark"      => checksinglequote($remark)
            );
            $where = "id = " . $id;

            if ($db->update($table, $data, $where)) {
                echo $db->getResult();
            } else {
                echo $db->getResult();
            }
        } else {
            echo json_encode(array(
                "success" => "false",
                "status"  => "Error",
                "message" => "ID tidak valid untuk proses update."
            ));
        }
    break;

    // ==========================================
    // 6. DELETE (Hapus Data Gudang)
    // ==========================================
    case ('delete'):
        $deleteId = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);

        if ($deleteId > 0) {
            $where  = "id = " . $deleteId;
            $queryC = deleteQ($table, $where) . ";";

            $db->cmdQ($queryC);
            echo $db->getResult();
        } else {
            echo json_encode(array(
                "success" => "false",
                "status"  => "Error",
                "message" => "ID tidak valid untuk proses penghapusan data."
            ));
        }
    break;

    default:
        echo json_encode(array(
            "success" => "false",
            "status"  => "Error",
            "message" => "Task atau perintah tidak dikenali."
        ));
    break;
}

## File: ./php-crud/journal.entryCRD.php

<?php
/*
  Document      : Journal Entry - CRUD Handler
  Called from   : js/journal.entry.js
  Note          : - Jurnal manual pakai reference_type = 'manual_entry',
                    reference_id = 0 (tidak terkait dokumen sumber lain).
                  - Jurnal hanya boleh dibuat/diedit selagi status = 'draft'
                    dan periode masih Open.
                  - 'Batalkan posting' dilakukan lewat REVERSE: membuat jurnal
                    baru dengan baris debit/kredit dibalik, lalu status jurnal
                    asal diubah jadi 'reversed'. Ini menjaga jejak audit,
                    bukan menghapus/mengubah data historis.
                  - Total debit/kredit dihitung on-the-fly dari journal_lines,
                    tidak disimpan terpisah di header (sesuai struktur asli).
                  - Periode akuntansi pakai tabel accounting_periods.
*/
if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) { session_start(); }

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

if (!isset($_SESSION["user_id"]) || empty($_SESSION["user_id"])) {
    http_response_code(401);
    echo json_encode(["success" => false, "message" => "Session expired. Silakan login kembali."]);
    exit;
}

$task = $_POST['task'] ?? $_REQUEST['task'] ?? 'read';
$db   = new crud();

switch ($task) {

    // ==============================================================
    case 'read':
        $query = $_POST['query'] ?? null;
        $srch  = searchData($query, ['j.ref_no', 'j.description']);

        $where = "j.reference_type = 'manual_entry' or j.reference_type = 'closing_entry'" . ($srch['searchSQL'] ?? '');
        $limit = $srch['limit'] ?? 250;

        $sql = "
            SELECT j.id, j.ref_no, j.journal_date, j.period_id, p.period_name,
                   j.description, j.status,
                   COALESCE((SELECT SUM(debit)  FROM journal_lines WHERE journal_id = j.id), 0) AS total_debit,
                   COALESCE((SELECT SUM(credit) FROM journal_lines WHERE journal_id = j.id), 0) AS total_credit
            FROM journal_entries j
            LEFT JOIN accounting_periods p ON p.id = j.period_id
            
            ORDER BY j.journal_date DESC, j.id DESC
            LIMIT " . intval($limit);

        $stmt = $db->query($sql);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'status' => 'Success', 'totalCount' => count($data), 'data' => $data]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    case 'read_edit':
        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT * FROM journal_entries WHERE id = :id");
        $stmt->execute(['id' => $id]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => (bool)$row, 'data' => $row ?: new stdClass()]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    case 'read_lines':
        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        if ($id <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'totalCount' => 0, 'data' => []]);
            exit;
        }
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            SELECT l.id AS line_id, l.account_id, c.account_code, c.account_name,
                   l.debit, l.credit, l.description
            FROM journal_lines l
            LEFT JOIN chart_of_accounts c ON c.id = l.account_id
            WHERE l.journal_id = :id
            ORDER BY l.id ASC
        ");
        $stmt->execute(['id' => $id]);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($data), 'data' => $data]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    case 'create':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 2) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }
        saveJournal($db, null, $_POST);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    case 'update':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 3) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }
        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        if ($id <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'ID jurnal tidak valid.']);
            exit;
        }

        $stmtChk = $db->prepare("SELECT status FROM journal_entries WHERE id = :id");
        $stmtChk->execute(['id' => $id]);
        $existing = $stmtChk->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if ($existing && $existing['status'] !== 'draft') {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Hanya jurnal berstatus Draft yang boleh diedit.']);
            exit;
        }

        saveJournal($db, $id, $_POST);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
     case 'post':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 3) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }
        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        $userId = $_SESSION['user_id'];
 
        $stmtUpd = $db->prepare("
            UPDATE journal_entries
            SET status = 'posted', posted_by = :uid, posted_at = now()
            WHERE id = :id AND status = 'draft'
        ");
        $stmtUpd->execute(['uid' => $userId, 'id' => $id]);
 
        if ($stmtUpd->rowCount() === 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Gagal posting -- data tidak ditemukan atau status sudah bukan Draft (mungkin sudah di-post/reload halaman lain).']);
            exit;
        }
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Jurnal berhasil di-post.']);
        break;


    
    // ==============================================================
    case 'reverse':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 4) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Hanya akses tertinggi yang boleh reverse jurnal.']);
            exit;
        }
        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);

        $stmtChk = $db->prepare("SELECT * FROM journal_entries WHERE id = :id");
        $stmtChk->execute(['id' => $id]);
        $original = $stmtChk->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if (!$original || $original['status'] !== 'posted') {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Hanya jurnal berstatus Posted yang bisa di-reverse.']);
            exit;
        }

        $stmtP = $db->prepare("SELECT is_closed FROM accounting_periods WHERE id = :id");
        $stmtP->execute(['id' => $original['period_id']]);
        $period = $stmtP->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if ($period && $period['is_closed']) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Periode jurnal asal sudah ditutup, reverse tidak bisa dilakukan pada periode ini.']);
            exit;
        }

        $reverseNo = CreateRefNo('journal_entries', 'ref_no', 'JE');
        $db->insert('journal_entries', [
            'ref_no'     => $reverseNo,
            'journal_date'   => date('Y-m-d'),
            'period_id'      => $original['period_id'],
            'reference_type' => 'manual_entry',
            'reference_id'   => 0,
            'description'    => 'Reversal dari ' . $original['ref_no'] . (empty($original['description']) ? '' : ' - ' . $original['description']),
            'status'         => 'posted',
            'posted_by'      => $_SESSION['user_id'],
            'posted_at'      => date('Y-m-d H:i:s')
        ]);

        $stmtNewId = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM journal_entries WHERE ref_no = :no");
        $stmtNewId->execute(['no' => $reverseNo]);
        $newId = $stmtNewId->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)['id'] ?? null;

        if ($newId) {
            $stmtLines = $db->prepare("SELECT account_id, debit, credit, description FROM journal_lines WHERE journal_id = :id");
            $stmtLines->execute(['id' => $id]);
            $origLines = $stmtLines->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            foreach ($origLines as $l) {
                $db->insert('journal_lines', [
                    'journal_id'  => $newId,
                    'account_id'  => $l['account_id'],
                    'debit'       => $l['credit'],
                    'credit'      => $l['debit'],
                    'description' => $l['description']
                ]);
            }
        }

        $db->update('journal_entries', ['status' => 'reversed'], "id = {$id}");
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => "Jurnal berhasil di-reverse. Jurnal koreksi: {$reverseNo}"]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    case 'delete':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 4) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }
        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);

        $stmtChk = $db->prepare("SELECT status FROM journal_entries WHERE id = :id");
        $stmtChk->execute(['id' => $id]);
        $row = $stmtChk->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if ($row && $row['status'] !== 'draft') {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Hanya jurnal berstatus Draft yang boleh dihapus.']);
            exit;
        }

        $db->query("DELETE FROM journal_lines WHERE journal_id = {$id}");
        $db->query("DELETE FROM journal_entries WHERE id = {$id}");
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Jurnal berhasil dihapus.']);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    default:
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Task tidak dikenali: ' . htmlspecialchars($task)]);
}

function saveJournal($db, $id, $post) {
    $journalDate = trim($post['journal_date'] ?? '');
    $periodId    = intval($post['period_id'] ?? 0);
    $desc        = $post['description'] ?? null;
    $linesJson   = $post['arrLines'] ?? '[]';
    $lines       = json_decode($linesJson, true);

    if (empty($journalDate)) {
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Tanggal jurnal wajib diisi.']);
        return;
    }
    if ($periodId <= 0) {
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Periode akuntansi wajib dipilih.']);
        return;
    }

    $stmtP = $db->prepare("SELECT is_closed FROM accounting_periods WHERE id = :id");
    $stmtP->execute(['id' => $periodId]);
    $period = $stmtP->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if (!$period) {
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Periode akuntansi tidak ditemukan.']);
        return;
    }
    if ($period['is_closed']) {
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Periode ini sudah ditutup, tidak bisa menambah jurnal.']);
        return;
    }

    if (!is_array($lines) || count($lines) < 2) {
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Jurnal minimal harus punya 2 baris (debit & kredit).']);
        return;
    }

    $totalDebit = 0;
    $totalCredit = 0;
    $validLines = [];
    foreach ($lines as $l) {
        $accId  = intval($l['account_id'] ?? 0);
        $debit  = Str2N($l['debit'] ?? 0);
        $credit = Str2N($l['credit'] ?? 0);
        if ($accId <= 0) continue;
        if ($debit == 0 && $credit == 0) continue;
        if ($debit > 0 && $credit > 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Satu baris tidak boleh diisi debit dan kredit sekaligus.']);
            return;
        }
        $totalDebit  += $debit;
        $totalCredit += $credit;
        $validLines[] = ['account_id' => $accId, 'debit' => $debit, 'credit' => $credit, 'description' => $l['description'] ?? null];
    }

    if (count($validLines) < 2) {
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Jurnal minimal harus punya 2 baris valid (ada akun & nominal).']);
        return;
    }

    if (abs($totalDebit - $totalCredit) > 0.01) {
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => "Jurnal tidak balance! Total Debit: {$totalDebit}, Total Kredit: {$totalCredit}"]);
        return;
    }

    $headerData = [
        'journal_date' => $journalDate,
        'period_id'    => $periodId,
        'description'  => $desc
    ];

    if ($id === null) {
        $journalNo = CreateRefNo('journal_entries', 'ref_no', 'JE');
        $headerData['ref_no']     = $journalNo;
        $headerData['reference_type'] = 'manual_entry';
        $headerData['reference_id']   = 0;
        $headerData['status']         = 'draft';

        $db->insert('journal_entries', $headerData);

        $stmtId = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM journal_entries WHERE ref_no = :no");
        $stmtId->execute(['no' => $journalNo]);
        $newId = $stmtId->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)['id'] ?? null;

        if ($newId) {
            insertLines($db, $newId, $validLines);
        }
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => "Jurnal {$journalNo} berhasil disimpan."]);
    } else {
        $db->update('journal_entries', $headerData, "id = {$id}");
        $db->query("DELETE FROM journal_lines WHERE journal_id = {$id}");
        insertLines($db, $id, $validLines);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Jurnal berhasil diperbarui.']);
    }
}

function insertLines($db, $journalId, $lines) {
    foreach ($lines as $l) {
        $db->insert('journal_lines', [
            'journal_id'  => $journalId,
            'account_id'  => $l['account_id'],
            'debit'       => $l['debit'],
            'credit'      => $l['credit'],
            'description' => $l['description']
        ]);
    }
}

  function periodName(val, x, store){

  }
  Ext.EventManager.addListener(Ext.getBody(), 'keydown', function(e){
    if(e.getTarget().type != 'text' && e.getTarget().type != 'textarea' && e.getTarget().type != 'password' && e.getKey() == '8' ){e.preventDefault();}
    if (e.getTarget().id == 'q' && (e.getKey() == '13' || e.getKey() == '9')) {
      SearchData=document.getElementById('q').value;
      mainDs.load({params: {query: SearchData}});
      //mainDs.baseParams = {task: 'read', start: 0, limit: 50};

      SearchData=document.getElementById('qAdd').value;
      gridAddEditorDs.load({params: {query: SearchData, iteminfo: Array2Json(ArrayItem)}});

      let container = document.getElementById('schPlywoodData');
      // Create a DataSet (allows two way data-binding)
      let groups = new vis.DataSet([
        {id: 0, content: 'Production Line 1', value: 1},
        {id: 1, content: 'Production Line 3', value: 3},
        {id: 2, content: 'Production Line 2', value: 2, className: 'blue'}
      ]);
      let items = new vis.DataSet([
        {id: 0, group: 0, content: 'Order X - item 0', start: new Date(2018, 12, 17), end: new Date(2018, 12, 21)},
        {id: 1, group: 0, content: 'Order Y - item 1', start: new Date(2018, 12, 21), end: new Date(2018, 12, 29)},

        {id: 4, group: 1, content: 'Order Z - item 4', start: new Date(2019, 1, 10), end: new Date(2019, 1, 26)},
        {id: 5, group: 2, content: 'Order X - item 5', start: new Date(2018, 12, 10), end: new Date(2018, 12, 27)}
      ]);
      // Configuration for the Timeline
      let options = {
        // option groupOrder can be a property name or a sort function
        // the sort function must compare two groups and return a value
        //     > 0 when a > b
        //     < 0 when a < b
        //       0 when a == b
        groupOrder: function (a, b) {return a.value - b.value;},
        editable: false
      };
      // Create a Timeline
      function onSelect (properties) {alert('selected items: ' + properties.nodes);}
      let timeline = new vis.Timeline(container);
      timeline.setOptions(options);
      timeline.setGroups(groups);
      timeline.setItems(items);
      timeline.on('select', onSelect);
    </script>

function each(loopable, fn, thisArg, reverse) {
    let i, len, keys;
    if (isArray(loopable)) {
        len = loopable.length;
        if (reverse) {
            for(i = len - 1; i >= 0; i--){
                fn.call(thisArg, loopable[i], i);
            }
        } else {
            for(i = 0; i < len; i++){
                fn.call(thisArg, loopable[i], i);
            }
        }
    } else if (isObject(loopable)) {
        keys = Object.keys(loopable);
        len = keys.length;
        for(i = 0; i < len; i++){
            fn.call(thisArg, loopable[keys[i]], keys[i]);
        }
    }
}
/**
 * Returns true if the `a0` and `a1` arrays have the same content, else returns false.
 * @param a0 - The array to compare
 * @param a1 - The array to compare
 * @private
 */ function _elementsEqual(a0, a1) {

        return false;

/**
 * Returns a deep copy of `source` without keeping references on objects and arrays.
 * @param source - The value to clone.
 */ function clone(source) {
    if (isArray(source)) {
        return source.map(clone);
    }
    if (isObject(source)) {
        const target = Object.create(null);
        const keys = Object.keys(source);
        const klen = keys.length;
        let k = 0;
        for(; k < klen; ++k){
            target[keys[k]] = clone(source[keys[k]]);
        }
        return target;
    }
    return source;
}

/**
 * The default merger when Chart.helpers.merge is called without merger option.
 * Note(SB): also used by mergeConfig and mergeScaleConfig as fallback.
 * @private
 */ function _merger(key, target, source, options) {
    if (!isValidKey(key)) {
        return;
    }
    const tval = target[key];
    const sval = source[key];
    if (isObject(tval) && isObject(sval)) {

function merge(target, source, options) {
    const sources = isArray(source) ? source : [
        source
    ];
    const ilen = sources.length;
    if (!isObject(target)) {
        return target;
    }
    options = options || {};
    const merger = options.merger || _merger;
    let current;
    for(let i = 0; i < ilen; ++i){
        current = sources[i];
        if (!isObject(current)) {
            continue;
        }
        const keys = Object.keys(current);
        for(let k = 0, klen = keys.length; k < klen; ++k){
            merger(keys[k], target, current, options);
        }
    }
    return target;
}

/**
 * @private
 */ function _splitKey(key) {
    const parts = key.split('.');
    const keys = [];
    let tmp = '';

        tmp += part;
        if (tmp.endsWith('\\')) {
            tmp = tmp.slice(0, -1) + '.';

    };

/**
 * Implementation of the nice number algorithm used in determining where axis labels will go
 */ function niceNum(range) {
    const roundedRange = Math.round(range);
    range = almostEquals(range, roundedRange, range / 1000) ? roundedRange : range;
    const niceRange = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(log10(range)));
    const fraction = range / niceRange;
    const niceFraction = fraction <= 1 ? 1 : fraction <= 2 ? 2 : fraction <= 5 ? 5 : 10;
    return niceFraction * niceRange;
}
/**
 * Returns an array of factors sorted from 1 to sqrt(value)
 * @private
 */ function _factorize(value) {
    const result = [];
    const sqrt = Math.sqrt(value);
    let i;
    for(i = 1; i < sqrt; i++){
        if (value % i === 0) {
            result.push(i);
            result.push(value / i);
        }
    }
    if (sqrt === (sqrt | 0)) {
        result.push(sqrt);
    }
    result.sort((a, b)=>a - b).pop();
    return result;
}

// Gets the angle from vertical upright to the point about a centre.
function getAngleFromPoint(centrePoint, anglePoint) {
    const distanceFromXCenter = anglePoint.x - centrePoint.x;
    const distanceFromYCenter = anglePoint.y - centrePoint.y;
    const radialDistanceFromCenter = Math.sqrt(distanceFromXCenter * distanceFromXCenter + distanceFromYCenter * distanceFromYCenter);
    let angle = Math.atan2(distanceFromYCenter, distanceFromXCenter);
    if (angle < -0.5 * PI) {
        angle += TAU; // make sure the returned angle is in the range of (-PI/2, 3PI/2]
    }
    return {
        angle,
        distance: radialDistanceFromCenter
    };
}

/**

 */ function _angleBetween(angle, start, end, sameAngleIsFullCircle) {

    const s = _normalizeAngle(start);
    const e = _normalizeAngle(end);
    const angleToStart = _normalizeAngle(s - a);

}

function _lookup(table, value, cmp) {
    cmp = cmp || ((index)=>table[index] < value);
    let hi = table.length - 1;
    let lo = 0;
    let mid;
    while(hi - lo > 1){
        mid = lo + hi >> 1;
        if (cmp(mid)) {
            lo = mid;
        } else {
            hi = mid;
        }
    }
    return {
        lo,
        hi
    };
}

/**
 * Return subset of `values` between `min` and `max` inclusive.
 * Values are assumed to be in sorted order.
 * @param values - sorted array of values
 * @param min - min value
 * @param max - max value
 */ function _filterBetween(values, min, max) {
    let start = 0;
    let end = values.length;
    while(start < end && values[start] < min){
        start++;
    }
    while(end > start && values[end - 1] > max){
        end--;
    }
    return start > 0 || end < values.length ? values.slice(start, end) : values;
}
const arrayEvents = [
    'push',
    'pop',
    'shift',
    'splice',
    'unshift'

function listenArrayEvents(array, listener) {
    if (array._chartjs) {
        array._chartjs.listeners.push(listener);
        return;
    }
    Object.defineProperty(array, '_chartjs', {
        configurable: true,
        enumerable: false,
        value: {
            listeners: [
                listener
            ]
        }
    });
    arrayEvents.forEach((key)=>{
        const method = '_onData' + _capitalize(key);
        const base = array[key];
        Object.defineProperty(array, key, {
            configurable: true,
            enumerable: false,
            value (...args) {
                const res = base.apply(this, args);
                array._chartjs.listeners.forEach((object)=>{
                    if (typeof object[method] === 'function') {
                        object[method](...args);
                    }
                });
                return res;
            }
        });
    });
}
function unlistenArrayEvents(array, listener) {
    const stub = array._chartjs;
    if (!stub) {
        return;
    }
    const listeners = stub.listeners;
    const index = listeners.indexOf(listener);
    if (index !== -1) {
        listeners.splice(index, 1);
    }
    if (listeners.length > 0) {
        return;
    }
    arrayEvents.forEach((key)=>{
        delete array[key];
    });
    delete array._chartjs;
}

    }
    return Array.from(set);
}

/**
 * Throttles calling `fn` once per animation frame
 * Latest arguments are used on the actual call
 */ function throttled(fn, thisArg) {
    let argsToUse = [];
    let ticking = false;
    return function(...args) {
        // Save the args for use later
        argsToUse = args;
        if (!ticking) {
            ticking = true;
            requestAnimFrame.call(window, ()=>{
                ticking = false;
                fn.apply(thisArg, argsToUse);
            });
        }
    };
}
/**
 * Debounces calling `fn` for `delay` ms
 */ function debounce(fn, delay) {
    let timeout;
    return function(...args) {
        if (delay) {
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            timeout = setTimeout(fn, delay, args);
        } else {
            fn.apply(this, args);
        }
        return delay;
    };
}

    if (meta._sorted) {
        const { iScale , vScale , _parsed  } = meta;
        const spanGaps = meta.dataset ? meta.dataset.options ? meta.dataset.options.spanGaps : null : null;
        const axis = iScale.axis;
        const { min , max , minDefined , maxDefined  } = iScale.getUserBounds();
        if (minDefined) {
            start = Math.min(// @ts-expect-error Need to type _parsed
            _lookupByKey(_parsed, axis, min).lo, // @ts-expect-error Need to fix types on _lookupByKey
            animationsDisabled ? pointCount : _lookupByKey(points, axis, iScale.getPixelForValue(min)).lo);
            if (spanGaps) {
                const distanceToDefinedLo = _parsed.slice(0, start + 1).reverse().findIndex((point)=>!isNullOrUndef(point[vScale.axis]));
                start -= Math.max(0, distanceToDefinedLo);
            }
            start = _limitValue(start, 0, pointCount - 1);
        }
        if (maxDefined) {
            let end = Math.max(// @ts-expect-error Need to type _parsed
            _lookupByKey(_parsed, iScale.axis, max, true).hi + 1, // @ts-expect-error Need to fix types on _lookupByKey
            animationsDisabled ? 0 : _lookupByKey(points, axis, iScale.getPixelForValue(max), true).hi + 1);
            if (spanGaps) {
                const distanceToDefinedHi = _parsed.slice(end - 1).findIndex((point)=>!isNullOrUndef(point[vScale.axis]));
                end += Math.max(0, distanceToDefinedHi);
            }
            count = _limitValue(end, start, pointCount) - start;
        } else {
            count = pointCount - start;
        }
    }
    return {
        start,
        count
    };
}
/**
 * Checks if the scale ranges have changed.
 * @param {object} meta - dataset meta.
 * @returns {boolean}
 * @private
 */ function _scaleRangesChanged(meta) {
    const { xScale , yScale , _scaleRanges  } = meta;
    const newRanges = {
        xmin: xScale.min,
        xmax: xScale.max,
        ymin: yScale.min,
        ymax: yScale.max
    };
    if (!_scaleRanges) {
        meta._scaleRanges = newRanges;
        return true;
    }
    const changed = _scaleRanges.xmin !== xScale.min || _scaleRanges.xmax !== xScale.max || _scaleRanges.ymin !== yScale.min || _scaleRanges.ymax !== yScale.max;
    Object.assign(_scaleRanges, newRanges);
    return changed;
}

const atEdge = (t)=>t === 0 || t === 1;
const elasticIn = (t, s, p)=>-(Math.pow(2, 10 * (t -= 1)) * Math.sin((t - s) * TAU / p));
const elasticOut = (t, s, p)=>Math.pow(2, -10 * t) * Math.sin((t - s) * TAU / p) + 1;
/**
 * Easing functions adapted from Robert Penner's easing equations.
 * @namespace Chart.helpers.easing.effects
 * @see http://www.robertpenner.com/easing/
 */ const effects = {
    linear: (t)=>t,
    easeInQuad: (t)=>t * t,
    easeOutQuad: (t)=>-t * (t - 2),
    easeInOutQuad: (t)=>(t /= 0.5) < 1 ? 0.5 * t * t : -0.5 * (--t * (t - 2) - 1),
    easeInCubic: (t)=>t * t * t,
    easeOutCubic: (t)=>(t -= 1) * t * t + 1,
    easeInOutCubic: (t)=>(t /= 0.5) < 1 ? 0.5 * t * t * t : 0.5 * ((t -= 2) * t * t + 2),
    easeInQuart: (t)=>t * t * t * t,
    easeOutQuart: (t)=>-((t -= 1) * t * t * t - 1),
    easeInOutQuart: (t)=>(t /= 0.5) < 1 ? 0.5 * t * t * t * t : -0.5 * ((t -= 2) * t * t * t - 2),
    easeInQuint: (t)=>t * t * t * t * t,
    easeOutQuint: (t)=>(t -= 1) * t * t * t * t + 1,
    easeInOutQuint: (t)=>(t /= 0.5) < 1 ? 0.5 * t * t * t * t * t : 0.5 * ((t -= 2) * t * t * t * t + 2),
    easeInSine: (t)=>-Math.cos(t * HALF_PI) + 1,
    easeOutSine: (t)=>Math.sin(t * HALF_PI),
    easeInOutSine: (t)=>-0.5 * (Math.cos(PI * t) - 1),
    easeInExpo: (t)=>t === 0 ? 0 : Math.pow(2, 10 * (t - 1)),
    easeOutExpo: (t)=>t === 1 ? 1 : -Math.pow(2, -10 * t) + 1,
    easeInOutExpo: (t)=>atEdge(t) ? t : t < 0.5 ? 0.5 * Math.pow(2, 10 * (t * 2 - 1)) : 0.5 * (-Math.pow(2, -10 * (t * 2 - 1)) + 2),
    easeInCirc: (t)=>t >= 1 ? t : -(Math.sqrt(1 - t * t) - 1),
    easeOutCirc: (t)=>Math.sqrt(1 - (t -= 1) * t),
    easeInOutCirc: (t)=>(t /= 0.5) < 1 ? -0.5 * (Math.sqrt(1 - t * t) - 1) : 0.5 * (Math.sqrt(1 - (t -= 2) * t) + 1),
    easeInElastic: (t)=>atEdge(t) ? t : elasticIn(t, 0.075, 0.3),
    easeOutElastic: (t)=>atEdge(t) ? t : elasticOut(t, 0.075, 0.3),
    easeInOutElastic (t) {
        const s = 0.1125;
        const p = 0.45;
        return atEdge(t) ? t : t < 0.5 ? 0.5 * elasticIn(t * 2, s, p) : 0.5 + 0.5 * elasticOut(t * 2 - 1, s, p);
    },
    easeInBack (t) {
        const s = 1.70158;
        return t * t * ((s + 1) * t - s);
    },
    easeOutBack (t) {
        const s = 1.70158;
        return (t -= 1) * t * ((s + 1) * t + s) + 1;
    },
    easeInOutBack (t) {
        let s = 1.70158;
        if ((t /= 0.5) < 1) {
            return 0.5 * (t * t * (((s *= 1.525) + 1) * t - s));
        }
        return 0.5 * ((t -= 2) * t * (((s *= 1.525) + 1) * t + s) + 2);
    },
    easeInBounce: (t)=>1 - effects.easeOutBounce(1 - t),
    easeOutBounce (t) {
        const m = 7.5625;
        const d = 2.75;
        if (t < 1 / d) {
            return m * t * t;
        }
        if (t < 2 / d) {
            return m * (t -= 1.5 / d) * t + 0.75;
        }
        if (t < 2.5 / d) {
            return m * (t -= 2.25 / d) * t + 0.9375;
        }
        return m * (t -= 2.625 / d) * t + 0.984375;
    },
    easeInOutBounce: (t)=>t < 0.5 ? effects.easeInBounce(t * 2) * 0.5 : effects.easeOutBounce(t * 2 - 1) * 0.5 + 0.5
};

function isPatternOrGradient(value) {
    if (value && typeof value === 'object') {
        const type = value.toString();
        return type === '[object CanvasPattern]' || type === '[object CanvasGradient]';
    }
    return false;
}
function color(value) {
    return isPatternOrGradient(value) ? value : new Color(value);
}
function getHoverColor(value) {
    return isPatternOrGradient(value) ? value : new Color(value).saturate(0.5).darken(0.1).hexString();
}

const intlCache = new Map();
function getNumberFormat(locale, options) {
    options = options || {};
    const cacheKey = locale + JSON.stringify(options);
    let formatter = intlCache.get(cacheKey);
    if (!formatter) {
        formatter = new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, options);
        intlCache.set(cacheKey, formatter);
    }
    return formatter;
}
function formatNumber(num, locale, options) {
    return getNumberFormat(locale, options).format(num);
}

const formatters = {
 values (value) {
        return isArray(value) ?  value : '' + value;
    },
 numeric (tickValue, index, ticks) {
        if (tickValue === 0) {
            return '0';
        }
        const locale = this.chart.options.locale;
        let notation;
        let delta = tickValue;
        if (ticks.length > 1) {
            const maxTick = Math.max(Math.abs(ticks[0].value), Math.abs(ticks[ticks.length - 1].value));
            if (maxTick < 1e-4 || maxTick > 1e+15) {
                notation = 'scientific';
            }
            delta = calculateDelta(tickValue, ticks);
        }
        const logDelta = log10(Math.abs(delta));
        const numDecimal = isNaN(logDelta) ? 1 : Math.max(Math.min(-1 * Math.floor(logDelta), 20), 0);
        const options = {
            notation,
            minimumFractionDigits: numDecimal,
            maximumFractionDigits: numDecimal
        };
        Object.assign(options, this.options.ticks.format);
        return formatNumber(tickValue, locale, options);
    },
 logarithmic (tickValue, index, ticks) {
        if (tickValue === 0) {
            return '0';
        }
        const remain = ticks[index].significand || tickValue / Math.pow(10, Math.floor(log10(tickValue)));
        if ([
            1,
            2,
            3,
            5,
            10,
            15
        ].includes(remain) || index > 0.8 * ticks.length) {
            return formatters.numeric.call(this, tickValue, index, ticks);
        }
        return '';
    }
};
function calculateDelta(tickValue, ticks) {
    let delta = ticks.length > 3 ? ticks[2].value - ticks[1].value : ticks[1].value - ticks[0].value;
    if (Math.abs(delta) >= 1 && tickValue !== Math.floor(tickValue)) {
        delta = tickValue - Math.floor(tickValue);
    }
    return delta;
}

    formatters
};

 function getScope$1(node, key) {
    if (!key) {
        return node;
    }
    const keys = key.split('.');
    for(let i = 0, n = keys.length; i < n; ++i){

}

        const scopeObject = getScope$1(this, scope);
        const targetScopeObject = getScope$1(this, targetScope);
        const privateName = '_' + name;
        Object.defineProperties(scopeObject, {
            [privateName]: {
                value: scopeObject[name],
                writable: true
            },
            [name]: {
                enumerable: true,
                get () {
                    const local = this[privateName];
                    const target = targetScopeObject[targetName];
                    if (isObject(local)) {
                        return Object.assign({}, target, local);
                    }
                    return valueOrDefault(local, target);
                },
                set (value) {
                    this[privateName] = value;
                }
            }
        });
    }

    }
